name: FRED (Federal Reserve Economic Data) API
agency: Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis

endpoints.description: Observations (data points) for a series ID

limits.notes: ~120 requests/minute per key (HTTP 429 over limit). One series per observations call. No hard daily cap documented.

llmDocs.summary: 800k+ US and international economic time series: GDP, inflation, interest rates, employment, money supply, exchange rates. Single best source for macro series.
llmDocs.queryGuide: Always set file_type=json. Get data via /series/observations?series_id=. Find series IDs with /series/search?search_text=. Common IDs: GDP, GDPC1 (real GDP), UNRATE (unemployment), CPIAUCSL (CPI), DGS10 (10yr Treasury), FEDFUNDS. Use observation_start/observation_end and units (e.g. pc1 for YoY %) to transform.

exampleQueries.intent: Search for series about 'median household income'

gotchas: file_type=json is required or you get XML.
Only one series_id per observations request; loop for multiple.
Missing values come back as '.' in the value field — handle before numeric parsing.
Rate limit is per-minute (~120); burst loops trigger 429.

compliance.redistributionNotes: FRED API ToS requires attribution to FRED. Underlying series carry source-specific copyrights (some third-party series restrict redistribution); check each series' copyright field before redistributing.
